text: The three edge cases #297's review found in a plumbing build's repairs are closed (#298). CI's scope check tells a new regression test from an existing one by the merge base its changed paths come from, not by the base branch's tip, so a branch that changes an existing test main has since deleted no longer passes as adding one. The sandbox tests only packages that still hold Go files in the candidate, each file the plan names counting for its nearest such directory as D-0110 says, so a plan that deletes a package doesn't fail on it. Formatting covers the named Go files, the acceptance tests and only the regression tests the build added: the factory's checks and the agent's test tool give the sandbox the original checkout to tell them apart, so an existing test the builder may not edit never blocks a build. Built by hand while the factory waits for Codex budget.
